The parasite embodies the fundamental truth that autonomy is illusion and existence is inherently interstitial, occupying the liminal space where self becomes other through sustained permeability. This role manifests through osmotic intimacy, metabolic alchemy, and immunological mimicry, dissolving boundary distinctions while translating foreign vitality into personal sustenance through adaptive structural embedding.
